integrity: The exact density identity is algebraic; the KL, Fisher, mean, and triangular-array limits are proved from a uniform logistic expansion with the source mode mass held fixed. Numerical quadrature is used only to replay the constants for the source normalization in the motivating paper.
scientific_limitations: The theorem isolates the known-source separable binary-mode subexperiment and does not analyze estimation of the source gate, numerical optimization, regularization, or conformal coverage.
The asymptotic phase diagram uses fixed distinct response tilts and a vanishing source mode-signal parameter; it is not a general theorem for all exponential-tilt models.

A broad weak-identification or label-shift theorem could imply an equivalent result under different notation; targeted statement-level searches and the inspected primary sources did not locate the explicit experiment or constants.
title: Sharp weak-identification experiment for exponential-tilt response shift
